description: This file appears to be a C source file implementing logic for managing split indices in a Git-like version control system. It includes functions for reading, writing, and managing split index data, including link extensions, cache modifications, and merging operations.

methods.description: Compares the content of two cache entries, ignoring certain flags.

methods.name: void prepare_to_write_split_index(struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Prepares the index for writing a split index, marking entries and setting bitmaps based on the shared status.

methods.name: void finish_writing_split_index(struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Cleans up and restores the index after writing a split index.

methods.name: void discard_split_index(struct index_state * istate)

methods.name: void save_or_free_index_entry(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
